incidents.name: Ocean BPool asymmetric single-sided join/exit with SideStaking
incidents.notes: Ocean's BPool join and exit maths are asymmetric for maximum single-sided deposits and SideStaking mirrored each join and exit with automatic datatoken staking, so repeatedly joining flash-swapped mOCEAN single-sided and exiting the BPT returned more mOCEAN than went in.

sources.ref: onchain review: the BPool logic contract 0xBB3051dF2D3E408DAE6E6dAa2296BC6215F0dCFd (the address the PoC header names as the vulnerable BPool code; the eight drained pools are clones of it) was created 2022-05-26T15:32:12Z by 0xc7ec1970b09224b317c52d92f37f5e1e4ff6b687, not the attack-tx sender 0x3fa8cf7fea68c8e76a9838d77889464ddfb6a6cf; no EIP-1967 events, 1490.6 days old. SideStaking 0x3EFDD8f728c8e774aB81D14d0B2F07a8238960f4 supplies the mirrored datatoken side. Loss stated in the project's own mOCEAN token, so no USD figure is asserted; ~127.86K mOCEAN is far above the $1,000 floor at any mOCEAN price traded around that date.
